Duetto playground

One dial, six settings. Move it and watch how far the system is allowed to wander from the body it is listening to.

  1. Mirror
  2. Low
  3. Moderate
  4. High
  5. Very high
  6. Unanchored

The system reproduces the performer's movement almost exactly. Faithful, and with nothing to offer back.
